findings.text: from_imas duplicates the native-IMAS slice extraction (grid dim1/dim2, psi, profile.psi, dpressure_dpsi, f_df_dpsi, psi_axis, psi_boundary, ip, separatrix outline, magnetic axis, x_points, boundary outline) that scripts/iter_prescribed_plasma/measure.py:89 prescribe_slice already owns; it should extend that owner rather than fork a second extraction, and the DINA identity test only passes because both paths happen to agree today.

assert result["limit_fraction"] == FLUX_FRACTION_LIMIT compares the measurement's own echoed constant against the constant, and measure_linkage sets that key from the same constant, so the assertion is true for any measurement and guards nothing.

the linkage and sign-flip guards are @pytest.mark.slow and skip at :37 when the MAST /work mirror is absent, so on any machine without the mirror the guard is silently inactive and a regression reads as a pass.
